# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(nnet)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
```

# 1. Raw Data & Cumulative Ego Network Construction

```{r data-construction}
# Load raw survey data
edges_raw <- read.csv(here("raw_dat", "alter_alter_edges.csv"))
netsurv_raw <- read.csv(here("raw_dat", "network_survey.csv"))
basic_raw <- read.csv(here("raw_dat", "basic_survey.csv"))

all_egos <- sort(unique(netsurv_raw$egoid))

# Compute structural metrics for each participant across waves 1-8
compute_ego_metrics <- function(ego) {
  alters <- sort(unique(netsurv_raw$alterid[netsurv_raw$egoid == ego]))
  n_alters <- length(alters)
  if (n_alters == 0) return(NULL)
  
  sub_edges <- edges_raw %>%
    filter(egoid == ego, vertex1 != ego, vertex2 != ego) %>%
    select(vertex1, vertex2) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(vertex1 %in% alters, vertex2 %in% alters)
  
  n_edges <- nrow(sub_edges)
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(sub_edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = alters))
  g <- simplify(g)
  
  dens <- edge_density(g)
  if (is.na(dens)) dens <- 0
  
  clust <- transitivity(g, type = "global")
  if (is.na(clust)) clust <- 0
  
  cent_betw <- centr_betw(g, directed = FALSE)$centralization
  if (is.nan(cent_betw) || is.na(cent_betw)) cent_betw <- 0
  
  cent_deg <- centr_degree(g, mode = "all")$centralization
  if (is.nan(cent_deg) || is.na(cent_deg)) cent_deg <- 0
  
  comps <- components(g)
  n_comps <- comps$no
  max_comp_size <- if (length(comps$csize) > 0) max(comps$csize) else 0
  prop_lcc <- if (n_alters > 0) max_comp_size / n_alters else 0
  
  if (max_comp_size > 1) {
    lgcc <- induced_subgraph(g, which(comps$membership == which.max(comps$csize)))
    diam_lgcc <- diameter(lgcc, directed = FALSE, weights = NA)
  } else {
    diam_lgcc <- 0
  }
  
  if (ecount(g) > 0) {
    set.seed(123)
    cl <- cluster_louvain(g)
    mod <- modularity(cl)
    if (is.nan(mod) || is.na(mod)) mod <- 0
  } else {
    mod <- 0
  }
  
  data.frame(
    vertex_id = ego,
    egoid = ego,
    size = n_alters,
    edges = n_edges,
    density = dens,
    clustering = clust,
    betweenness_centralization = cent_betw,
    degree_centralization = cent_deg,
    diameter = diam_lgcc,
    modularity = mod,
    n_components = n_comps,
    max_comp_size = max_comp_size,
    prop_lcc = prop_lcc
  )
}

ego_metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_egos, compute_ego_metrics))

demo_cols <- c("egoid", "gender_1", "race_1", "parentincome_1", "RegionUS",
               "Extraversion_1", "Openness_1", "Agreeableness_1", "Conscientiousness_1", "Neuroticism_1")

df_merged <- inner_join(ego_metrics_df, basic_raw[, demo_cols], by = "egoid")
df_analytic <- df_merged %>% filter(size >= 3, edges > 0)
```

# 2. K-Means Clustering & Typology Mapping

```{r clustering}
cluster_vars <- c("size", "modularity", "diameter", "betweenness_centralization", "density")
X_scaled <- scale(df_analytic[, cluster_vars])

set.seed(42)
km_fit <- kmeans(X_scaled, centers = 4, nstart = 100, iter.max = 100)

temp_clus <- km_fit$cluster
means_mat <- aggregate(X_scaled, by = list(temp_clus), FUN = mean)

clus_pearl <- which.max(means_mat$size)
clus_dense <- which.max(means_mat$density)
clus_star  <- which.max(means_mat$betweenness_centralization)
clus_seg   <- setdiff(1:4, c(clus_pearl, clus_dense, clus_star))

cluster_map <- c()
cluster_map[clus_pearl] <- 0
cluster_map[clus_seg]   <- 1
cluster_map[clus_star]  <- 2
cluster_map[clus_dense] <- 3

df_analytic$cluster_km <- cluster_map[temp_clus]
df_analytic$cluster_factor <- factor(df_analytic$cluster_km,
                                     levels = 0:3,
                                     labels = c("Pearl Collar", "Segmented", "Centered Star", "Regular Dense"))

table(df_analytic$cluster_factor)
```

# 3. Decision Tree Classification (Extension 2)

```{r decision-tree}
tree_fit <- rpart(
  cluster_factor ~ size + modularity + diameter + betweenness_centralization + density + n_components + prop_lcc,
  data = df_analytic,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart.control(cp = 0.01, maxdepth = 5, minsplit = 10)
)

rpart.plot(tree_fit, 
           type = 4, 
           extra = 104, 
           under = TRUE, 
           fallen.leaves = TRUE,
           box.palette = "BuGn",
           main = "Empirical Decision Tree for Personal Network Typologies")

pred_tree <- predict(tree_fit, type = "class")
cat("Decision Tree Accuracy:", mean(pred_tree == df_analytic$cluster_factor), "\n")
```

# 4. Statistical Regressions

```{r regressions}
inc_levels <- c("less than $25,000", "$25,000 - $49,999", "$50,000 - $74,999", 
                "$75,000 - $99,999", "$100,000 - $149,999", "$150,000 - $199,999", 
                "$200,000 - $249,999", "$250,000 or more")

dat_reg <- df_analytic %>%
  rename(cluster = cluster_factor, gender = gender_1, race = race_1) %>%
  filter(race != "Other", race != "", !is.na(gender), gender %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  mutate(gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Male", "Female"))) %>%
  mutate(race = factor(race, levels = c("African-American", "White", "Foreign Student", "Latino/a", "Asian-American"))) %>%
  mutate(foreign = if_else(race == "Foreign Student", "Foreign", "Not Foreign")) %>%
  mutate(foreign = factor(foreign, levels = c("Not Foreign", "Foreign"))) %>%
  mutate(asian = if_else(race == "Asian-American", "Asian", "Not Asian")) %>%
  mutate(asian = factor(asian, levels = c("Not Asian", "Asian"))) %>%
  mutate(inc = factor(parentincome_1, levels = inc_levels))

# Gender Model
mod_gender <- multinom(cluster ~ gender, data = dat_reg)
summary(mod_gender)

# Race Model
mod_race <- multinom(cluster ~ foreign + asian, data = dat_reg)
summary(mod_race)

# Income / SES Model
mod_ses <- multinom(cluster ~ inc, data = dat_reg)
summary(mod_ses)

# Big Five Personality Model
mod_big5 <- multinom(cluster ~ Extraversion_1 + Openness_1 + Agreeableness_1 + Conscientiousness_1 + Neuroticism_1, data = dat_reg)
summary(mod_big5)
```
